zscored_label: '<z-scored> / <total> entries z-scored (%)' beside the z-plot axis title; total = every receptor x PDB entry found at discovery, z-scored = >= 1 finite b_factor_z in the v2 profiles; TRACE_LBD-only entries that are z-scored are named ('incl. N TRACE_LBD')

partner.partner-rich: >= 50% of entries with a contacting partner chain

ligand.one dominant ligand: most common functional ligand in >= 50% of HOLO entries
ligand.highly diverse: unique ligands >= 60% of HOLO entries with a ligand

construct_diversity_high: distinct construct boundary patterns >= 50% of entries (>= 10 entries); construct = first/last UniProt residue of the entity's sequence alignment
point_mutants_common: >= 30% of entries carry >= 1 point substitution vs the reference sequence
resolution_broad: IQR >= 0.8 A or worst entry >= 3.5 A
low_coverage: < 50% of observed positions are supported (>= 5 entries)
heterogeneity_class: tertile of median IQR among receptors with >= 20 supported positions
construct_line: page shows engineered mutants when >= 20% of entries, fusion/chimera when >= 5% (or < 10 entries), internal deletions when >= 10% (or < 10 entries); every count stays in the summary table
caveats: at most 3, receptor-specific: no data / no professor map, TRACE_LBD fragments, weak coverage, internal deletions >= 50%, fusion >= 20%, ligand dominance >= 70%, crystal forms >= 50% of entries
substitution_classes: ENGINEERED / NATURAL_VARIANT / SEQUENCE_CONFLICT / DECLARED_OTHER from the depositor's _struct_ref_seq_dif (or a UniProt natural variant); UNDECLARED = no annotation; MODIFIED_RESIDUE = non-standard component on a reference residue
crystal_form: same space group and unit cell within 2% (lengths) and 2 degrees (angles)
engineered_mutant: entry with >= 1 residue the depositor marks 'engineered mutation' (_struct_ref_seq_dif, reference residue identical to ours) or the entity's _entity.pdbx_mutation lists at the same residue; UNCERTAIN = only conflict/unannotated differences, or a declared substitution that no observed residue confirms; see catalogue_mutation_audit_v2.csv
partner_identity: normalized gene-level identity (scripts/utils/partner_identity.py); DNA and same-receptor chains excluded; unidentified peptides count once
contexts: per entry with an LBD context (TRACE_LBD excluded): ligand state x partner category, and functional ligand CCD id(s) x partner identity(ies); several are joined in sorted order (deterministic)
